We can definitely help you narrow things down, but the best “personal shopper” on By Rotation is usually the Lender of each item.

To choose what’s right for you, try:

Messaging lenders via the envelope icon on a listing to ask about fit, condition, and availability.
Checking profiles: look at response rate, acceptance rate, reviews, and any Active/Muse/Pro badges for extra trust.
Reading descriptions carefully for fit notes and defects, and comparing photos to your usual styles.
Starting with lower‑value items if you’re new, then building reviews to unlock more categories and higher‑value pieces.

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
To keep things budget-friendly with us, you’ve got a few solid options:
Choose sensible rental pricing: Look for items where the daily/weekly/monthly rates seem reasonable compared to similar pieces. Weekly/monthly prices are often discounted, so longer rentals can work out cheaper overall.
Use new-renter discount: If it’s your first rental, you’ll automatically get 15% off at checkout (on rentals over £20, up to £15 off, and within 30 days of joining).
Refer friends for credit: Share your personal referral link so friends get £10 off their first rental or resale over £20; once they complete it, you get £10 credit toward your next rental or resale.
Use your lending earnings: If you also lend, you can pay for rentals using your in‑app balance, which lets you “recycle” your earnings into new outfits instead of paying out of pocket.
So, for a sensible budget: target items with good weekly/monthly rates, stack your first-time discount or referral credit when eligible, and, if you lend, use those earnings to soften the cost even more.

Damage/loss/theft: We mediate disputes and can arrange repair reimbursement or replacement/market value, based on evidence and our final decision.
